Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing agreements between community and technical colleges and four-year institutions of higher education to provide degree programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing agreements between community andtechnical colleges and fouryear institutions of higher education toprovide degree programs; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.50RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) One strategy to accomplish expansion of capacity forbaccalaureate degrees in underserved regions of the state is toallocate state funds for student enrollment to community and technicalcolleges and authorize the colleges to enter into agreements with aregional university or state college as defined in RCW 28B.10.016 or abranch campus under chapter 28B.45 RCW, to offer baccalaureate degreeprograms. (2) Subject to legislative appropriation for the purpose describedin this section: (a) A community or technical college may enter into agreements withone or more regional universities, branch campuses, or the state p. 1 HB 2210college to offer baccalaureate degree programs on the college campus;or (b) The college board may enter into a master agreement withregional universities, branch campuses, or the state college to offerbaccalaureate degree programs on multiple college campuses. (3) Allocation of funds by the college board shall be based onanalysis of gaps in service delivery, capacity, and student andemployer demand for programs. Students enrolled in programs under thissection are considered students of the regional university, branchcampus, or state college for all purposes including tuition andreporting of statefunded enrollments.
